```{=html}
<div id="map-aug01" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-aug01').setView([33.4600, 126.9000], 12);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }
  var pts = [
    { name:'🏨 Shilla Stay Jeju Airport', lat:33.48580289503151, lng:126.49091012883574, hotel:true, url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Shilla+Stay+Jeju+Airport' },
    { name:'Seongsan Ilchulbong (Sunrise Peak) 🌅', lat:33.4583, lng:126.9422, c:'#C62828', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seongsan+Ilchulbong+Jeju' },
    { name:'Haenyeo Diver Show 🤿', lat:33.464604859978465, lng:126.93627516215088, c:'#1565C0', url:'https://maps.app.goo.gl/Rnbz4s2sdFUvYDZG6' },
    { name:'Nolaba Ramen 🍜', lat:33.48284914231799, lng:126.37621955092507, c:'#43A047', url:'https://maps.app.goo.gl/USjTj739GHcDPqaZ9' },
    { name:'Gwangchigi Beach 🏖️', lat:33.4650, lng:126.9200, c:'#1976D2', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Gwangchigi+Beach+Jeju' },
    { name:'Umu Cafe ☕', lat:33.4059540478567, lng:126.25654873629324, c:'#AB47BC', url:'https://maps.app.goo.gl/9rWsErEPUwd7wSPu9' },
    { name:'Gamttanam (Orange Cafe) 🍊', lat:33.26235649570158, lng:126.49473094088607, c:'#FFA726', url:'https://maps.app.goo.gl/gwT68uXbakAW2xT88' },
    { name:'Jung Jong Jeju Black Pork BBQ 🐷', lat:33.49112408965034, lng:126.50181770217206, c:'#C62828', url:'https://maps.app.goo.gl/Wo5RRJGezrjXzfdP9' },
  ];
  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  pts.forEach(function(p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng], { icon: p.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(p.c) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + p.name + '</b>';
    if (p.url) html += '<br><a href="' + p.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
    window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: m, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng });
  });
})();
</script>
```

<div class="section-header">Early Morning — Sunrise Hike</div>

<div class="event-card morning" data-dt="2026-08-01T04:00" data-lat="33.48580289503151" data-lng="126.49091012883574">
  <div class="event-time">04:00</div>

    <div class="event-notes">🚗 <strong>~55 min drive</strong> to Seongsan Ilchulbong. Depart by <strong>04:10</strong> to arrive at 05:10–05:20 — leaving enough time to park, buy tickets, and hike up before sunrise.</div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="event-card morning" data-dt="2026-08-01T05:15" data-lat="33.4583" data-lng="126.9422">
  <div class="event-time">05:15</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag activity">🌅 Sunrise</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">Hike Seongsan Ilchulbong (Sunrise Peak)</div>
    <div class="event-notes">UNESCO World Heritage volcanic crater rising from the sea. The sunrise from the summit is one of Korea's most iconic sights.<br><br>
      <strong>🕔 Timeline:</strong>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>05:10–05:20</strong> — Arrive, park, buy tickets (₩2,000)</li>
        <li><strong>05:20–05:40</strong> — Hike up (20–30 min, can be steep)</li>
        <li><strong>05:40–06:00</strong> — Sunrise at the summit 🌅</li>
      </ul>
      Gate opens at 05:00 in summer. Bring a jacket — windy at the top. Headlamp helpful in pre-dawn dark.
    </div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seongsan+Ilchulbong+Jeju" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 Seongsan Peak</a>
      <a href="https://map.naver.com/p/search/성산일출봉" target="_blank" class="maps-link naver-link">🗺 Naver</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

    <div class="event-name">Haenyeo Diver Show</div>
    <div class="event-notes">Watch Jeju's legendary female free-divers (해녀) demonstrate their tradition of diving without equipment to harvest abalone, sea urchin, and seaweed. A living piece of UNESCO Intangible Heritage.<br><br>
      🕑 <strong>Show starts at 2:00 PM daily — closed Mondays.</strong><br>
      ⚠️ Arrive early to secure a good viewing spot as it fills up quickly.
